Our Story

For the past 15 years, Barbados has been a special place for our family. We’ve returned for its beautiful beaches, welcoming people and relaxed way of life.

In summer 2026, we were privileged to buy Carlton Ridge as our holiday home. As we prepare for our inaugural rental season, we can’t wait to open our doors and share our favourite corner of the island with you.
